bio: The Pic family’s André bistro unveils a dialogue between tradition and modernity depicted by a spot-on score and bolstered by a truly outstanding wine cellar, courtesy of the gastronomic parent establishment, and high-flying sakes. The family’s heritage is celebrated with Jacques's mosaic of red mullet and foie gras and his orange-laced iced soufflé. Local trout gravlax is dotted with veggie and spicy touches, half-way between a vibrant tribute and fresh new start.
